column4: One turn of an old key in the mortise lock of a cheap plywood hotel room door: a dry metallic clack of the bolt sliding home, close, a small quiet room
Two dull metallic knocks deep inside an old cast iron radiator and its water pipe, the heating ticking in an old building at night, heard from inside a small room
A drink can drops down the chute of an old vending machine with a hollow thunk and rolls against the flap, indoors, close
An old village church harmonium reed organ: one held minor chord swelling and fading away, slightly out of tune, wheezing bellows, in a small stone chapel with echo
An old wooden church pew creaks under shifting weight, in a small empty stone chapel with a soft echo
A match struck on a box and touched to a small candle wick, a short hiss and a crackle, a quiet stone chapel
A coin dropped through the slot of a wooden church offering box, landing on other coins inside, small stone chapel echo
A heavy old wooden church door opens with an iron latch clank and a long creak of its hinges, stone chapel echo

Room tone of a large cold damp empty stone church in a village: a faint wind whistling through the gap of an old wooden door, the hollow deep quiet of a high vault, very far crows outside, no music, no voices
A single drop of water falling from a high vault into a half full zinc bucket inside a large empty stone church: one clear metallic plink with a long cold echo
Pigeons startled in the dark roof space above a church vault: wings flapping and claws scrabbling on old boards, muffled through the ceiling, then a low coo
One old wooden floorboard creaking slowly up in the empty choir gallery of a large stone church, as if somebody shifted their weight, then silence
Slow heavy wet breathing behind a thick velvet curtain inside a small wooden confessional booth, close, no voice, no words
Wind moaning softly through the crack of a tall old church window and under its door, inside a big empty stone church, low and steady

Night inside a cheap run-down roadside motel room: the low electrical hum of a neon sign outside, an old fridge compressor through the wall, a loose window pane rattling now and then, a lorry passing far away on a highway, no music, no voices
A failing neon sign buzzing and crackling on the roof of a motel at night, irregular flicker clicks, heard through a closed window
A dirty bathroom extractor fan droning and rattling in a small tiled room, one loose blade ticking against its grille
An old bathroom tap left running into a stained ceramic sink, steady splashing water in a small tiled room
A leaking tap dripping slowly into a ceramic sink, irregular plops, a quiet small tiled bathroom at night
A few houseflies buzzing lazily and bumping against a dirty window pane in a stuffy small room
A big cockroach scuttling fast across a dry plaster wall, tiny clicking legs, very close
The rusty springs of a cheap sagging motel bed creaking and twanging as somebody lies down on it
A television heard muffled through a thin motel wall at night: indistinct boomy voices and canned laughter, no clear words
A man in the next room coughing hard, a heavy smoker's wet cough, heard through a thin wall
A man and a woman arguing in the next motel room, heard muffled through a thin wall at night, the voices completely indistinct with no words that can be made out, then a door slams
Slow fingernails scratching along the other side of a thin plasterboard wall, moving along it, very close, at night
Heavy slow footsteps walking across the floor of the room upstairs, creaking boards heard through the ceiling, then something heavy dragged across it, then silence
Three slow heavy knocks on a thin hollow plywood motel room door, heard from inside the room
A brass door security chain slid into its slot and hooked, a small metallic rattle
The little metal cover of a door peephole flicked aside, one tiny click
The door of an old cheap veneer wardrobe creaking open on dry hinges, a hanger rattling inside
A plastic shower curtain pulled along its metal rail, the rings scraping
An old toilet gurgling by itself at night, water bubbling up in the pipes of a cheap motel
A car slowly pulls into a gravel motel car park at night, the engine idling outside the window, then cut off, one car door shuts, then silence
A cheap fluorescent tube in a small bathroom flickering on with a ping and settling into a buzz
Slow breathing heard through the earpiece of an old telephone, crackly line hiss, nobody speaks
An electric insect zapper crackles sharply as a fly hits it, then its low hum
An old metal desk fan wobbling and ticking as it turns in a stuffy small motel reception, a slow hum
A shoe peeling off a sticky dirty carpet, a short tacky crackle
A small wood fire crackling inside a tiled stove in a quiet room, soft pops and a low draught in the flue, close and warm
A small cast iron stove door creaks open and clanks against its hinge
A split log dropped onto embers inside a cast iron stove, a wooden thud and a burst of sparks crackling
A cooling iron stove pipe ticking and pinging slowly in a silent room
One single call of a wooden cuckoo clock, two soft bellows pipe notes, in a quiet wood panelled room
The tiny wooden door of a cuckoo clock clacks open with a small spring whirr
Pulling the chain of a cuckoo clock's weight, a small ratchet clicking fast
A slow wooden wall clock pendulum ticking in a silent room, steady tick tock, nothing else
An old valve radio switched on: a heavy bakelite switch click, then a low mains hum slowly rising as the tubes warm up
A locked wooden cabinet with a glass door rattled by hand, the pane buzzing in its frame and a small lock catch holding
A small old hotel fridge compressor humming with a slight rattle and shudder, steady, in a quiet room
A small fridge door pulled open, the rubber seal unsticking, little glass bottles clinking inside
A small fridge door pushed shut with a soft rubber thud and a clink of bottles
The metal screw cap of a miniature spirits bottle twisted off, a small crack of the seal
One quick swallow from a small bottle and a dry breath out afterwards, close, a person alone
A VHS cassette pushed into an old video recorder, motorised loading clunks and a whirr
An old video recorder ejecting a VHS cassette, motor whirr and a plastic clunk
The quiet mechanical whirr and faint tape hiss of a video recorder playing, steady
The heavy wooden lid of an old radiogram cabinet lifted, a soft hinge creak
Vinyl record surface noise, gentle crackle and pops of a worn groove, no music at all
Sitting down heavily in an old sprung armchair, the springs creak and the cushion sighs
A small old aquarium air pump humming and bubbles rising steadily through water, in a quiet room
A fingernail tapping twice on the glass of a fish tank
Dry fish flakes shaken from a small tin onto water, a light rattle and patter
An old electric hot plate switched on, a rotary click and the coil ticking and pinging as it heats
A wet fingertip touching a hot iron plate, a short sharp sizzle
Greasy plates and a mug knocked together on a shelf, a dull ceramic clink
The two metal latches of an old cardboard suitcase snapped open one after the other
An old yellowed newspaper page lifted and turned, dry paper rustle
Slippers shuffling slowly on a linoleum floor, three dragging steps, then they stop
A small transistor radio's tuning wheel turned, whistles and static between stations, a voice that never comes clear
